offering_description.value: Operates online auction marketplaces that sell surplus, used and government-owned assets for businesses and public agencies. Sellers pay commissions and fees, and buyers bid online and arrange pickup or shipping.

primary_services.value: online auction marketplace; asset valuation and liquidation; pickup and logistics services

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations selling surplus assets and businesses buying them; B2G: federal, state and local government agencies selling surplus property

end_markets.value: government surplus; industrial equipment; vehicles; construction equipment; retail and consumer goods

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: seller commissions and buyer premiums on auction sales; service fees: fees for listing, valuation, pickup and logistics services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace that matches sellers with bidders, sold to agencies and corporations; service provider: asset disposition and logistics services for sellers, sold to businesses and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: sellers across US states, buyers nationwide and some abroad

specialization.value: related lines: public-sector surplus auctions, business surplus liquidation, and used equipment listings

distribution_channels.value: online: web-based auction sites where buyers bid on listed assets; direct sales: account teams selling marketplace services to government agencies and corporate sellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, surplus property disposal and export rules apply to auctions
